svg.title: Batch vs stream processing
svg.desc: The same page views feed two paths over one day. On the left they pile up in log files and a batch job processes all eight at 2 AM, so the report jumps from 0 to 8 at once. On the right a stream job handles each view the moment it arrives and the most read count ticks up one by one.
svg.text: Batch waits for 2 AM and does it all at once. Stream counts each view live.
